summary: Warm the Akamai cookie jar once per cold profile before the first POST.
reason: Akamai does not reject an unwarmed POST with an error: it resets the HTTP/2 stream with INTERNAL_ERROR and the HTTP/1.1 fallback then hangs to timeout. Measured cold 'products search' = 47s and exit 5; after one GET of /shop = 0.9s. The generated client has no post-construction hook, so the one-line call has to live inside client.New.
validated_outcome: Cold profile: products search 47s/exit5 -> 1.4s/exit0. Warm profile unaffected (warm short-circuits on a non-empty jar). Host-guarded to woolworths.com.au so httptest servers are untouched.
